ctx.title: Tara Sutaria joins Aditya Roy Kapur in Bhushan Kumar’s intense musical love story
ctx.summary: After announcing Aditya Roy Kapur as the male lead of Bhushan Kumar’s upcoming musical love story, the makers have now revealed Tara Sutaria as the film’s female lead.
